header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.title: OpenAEC Docs
header.desc: Open source BIM document management platform. Manage, share and archive all project documents in one central place.

what.title: What is OpenAEC Docs?
what.desc: OpenAEC Docs is a document management system (DMS) specifically designed for BIM projects in the construction industry. It is based on Nextcloud — the most popular open source platform for file management and collaboration. It provides a central place for managing, sharing and archiving all project documents — from drawings and reports to contracts and permits.
what.tech: A Rust server (Axum) and a React frontend on top of Nextcloud, with PostgreSQL for the metadata and sign-in through OIDC.

documents.title: Project files
documents.desc: Upload, open and delete files and create folders, per project and straight in Nextcloud.

folders.title: Fixed project folders
folders.desc: A fixed layout per project, such as models, drawings, calculations and reports, with allowed file types per folder.

manifests.title: Project manifest
manifests.desc: A manifest per project records which models, issue sets and reports belong to it, so other tools can find them.

integrations.title: BIM Validator and BCF
integrations.desc: Connections with the OpenAEC BIM Validator and BCF platform, for validations and issues next to the documents.

access.title: Sign-in and organisations
access.desc: Sign in through single sign-on (OIDC), with several organisations on one installation, each with its own Nextcloud.

api.title: REST API
api.desc: Every function through a REST API, for connections with other tools.

highlight.title: Self-hosted & privacy-first
highlight.desc: OpenAEC Docs runs on your own server via Docker. Full control over your data, no cloud dependency. Ideal for organizations with strict privacy and compliance requirements.
